title: The Matrix
facts: The Wachowskis wrote and directed The Matrix.
The Matrix won four Academy Awards: Film Editing, Sound, Sound Effects Editing, and Visual Effects.
The film was shot in Sydney, Australia.
The film's slow-motion camera effect became known as "bullet time".
Hong Kong action director Yuen Woo-ping choreographed the fights. The lead actors trained for months.
The Matrix opened in the United States on March 31, 1999.
Neo's name inside the Matrix is Thomas A. Anderson.
Morpheus's ship is named the Nebuchadnezzar.
Neo hides his disks in a hollowed-out copy of Jean Baudrillard's book Simulacra and Simulation.
In 2012 the Library of Congress selected The Matrix for the National Film Registry.
Two sequels, The Matrix Reloaded and The Matrix Revolutions, were both released in 2003.
Scenes inside the Matrix have a green tint. Scenes in the real world have a blue tint.
